encoding_notes: Encoded from Wayback snapshot (capture 20260709070154, dated 2026-07-09) of the live Author Guidelines tab; live journals.humankinetics.com page is bot-walled ('Human Verification' 405) and did not clear via headless render.

'Brief Report' is IJSPP's umbrella short-article type explicitly covering case studies (single case or small case series) and detailed technical/analytical reports; mapped to both case_report and case_series with the shared 1500-word / 12-reference limit.
Brief Report media cap is a COMBINED '3 tables or figures' (total <=3). Schema stores figures_max=3 and tables_max=3 separately; the real constraint is 3 figures+tables combined, not 3 of each.
Original Investigation reference cap is approximate: guide says '~30 references' / 'usually fewer than 30'; encoded references_max=30.

Invitation-only types omitted from article_types (not author-submittable): Brief Review (4500 words, 50-100 refs; abstract headings Purpose/Conclusions), Invited Commentary (2000 words), Consensus Statement (5000 words, 100 refs).
Single-anonymous peer review (reviewer identity concealed from authors; reviewers see author names/affiliations) -> no author blinding required.
Tables: manuscript page-order places tables last (grouped_end); ScholarOne submission additionally asks tables be uploaded as separate Word files.
Figure resolution is tiered: 300 dpi for photographs, 600 dpi for line art/graphs/charts/diagrams; min_dpi encoded as 300.
General/reference style follows AMA Manual of Style (latest edition); example journal citations use NLM-abbreviated journal names.

Keywords: exactly 5 keywords/phrases not repeating title wording; case and separator unspecified. Title limited to 25 words (no character limit stated); running head <=40 characters incl. spaces; academic degrees must NOT be listed for authors.
Margins stated only as 'wide' (non-numeric) -> null; page_size not stated -> null; heading case/format not specified -> null.

Conflict-of-interest disclosure required for all submissions (stated in Methods + cover letter); funding disclosed within Acknowledgments; IRB/ethics-approval statement required in Methods. No single ordered 'declarations' block prescribed, so declarations.order left empty.
